method: Independent cold inspection of each original through vision_analyze; parent review-ledger.json consulted only after all images were inspected. No boards substituted for originals.
scope: Static visual review only; no runtime animation, source geometry, archive verification or physical-device testing performed.

observations.desktop_closed: Six nested ivory diamond motifs and stitch border, thick ivory trim, tan panels, brass corner caps, centered clasp/round fitting, side ring and block feet are present and uncropped.
observations.desktop_open: Plain ivory inner lid and empty tan cavity are coherent. Dark rear hinge clearance and projecting clasp tab obscure precise attachment; stepped rim joints are visible.
observations.mobile_closed: Motif and closed silhouette remain readable; full object, title and side-by-side controls fit without horizontal clipping.
observations.mobile_open: Raised lid, tab and feet all fit; minor jagged edges and coarse rim joins, but no definite missing panel or major intersection.
observations.marketing: Same six-motif layout, ivory surround and brass hardware; smoother caramel surfaces and softer bevels than the viewer.

finish_limitations: Regular woven/ribbed body texture is stronger than the smoother promotional finish.
Ivory decoration reads as applied relief rather than pierced cutwork; marketing also shows applied raised motifs.
Small hardware and diagonal edges are simplified/aliased, especially on mobile.
uncertainties: Rear hinge contacts and upper clasp tab attachment cannot be certified from these angles; apparent separation is not confirmed detachment.
entries.reason: Identity, hardware and framing are coherent in all required views; differences are bounded finish limitations rather than demonstrated structural failures.
entries.parent_reconciliation: Consistent with parent's bounded visual pass; no final approval inferred.

observations.desktop_closed: Three differently sized pyramids on dune-like relief, ivory/honey strata, blue lid borders, brass clasp and side ring, and rounded pale feet preserve the reference identity.
observations.desktop_open: Empty stone-lined cavity and veined lid underside are visible; dark rim strips meet pale corner blocks abruptly, with a conspicuous rear-right notch/junction.
observations.mobile_closed: Complete pyramids, feet and body fit; title wraps cleanly. Dark under-lid seam looks pronounced but matches a blue band in the reference.
observations.mobile_open: Full raised lid and body are visible without clipping; small rim joins and metal details are jagged, and veining is repetitive.
observations.marketing: Three pyramids, thin blue lid outline and broad blue seam band, flowing tan strata, brass fittings and squat rounded feet match the principal model features.

finish_limitations: Viewer veining is more regular and contrasty than the promotional stone finish.
Pale corner blocks interrupt dark rim strips; feet and fittings are more faceted than marketing.
uncertainties: Fine rim continuity and hinge/tab contact need other angles or source inspection.
Pyramids are exterior lid ornament, hidden behind the raised lid in open views; their absence from that view is not missing geometry.
entries.reason: Three-pyramid identity and coherent closed/open construction survive both layouts; no definite gross breakage or clipping.
entries.parent_reconciliation: Consistent with parent's bounded pass; conspicuous trim joins remain finish observations, not established cracks.

observations.desktop_closed: Birch-marked body, exposed finger joints, cream lid, blue lake with three sage forms, green seam, brass fittings and gray rounded feet are all readable.
observations.desktop_open: Pale inner lid and empty cavity sit above the green rim; dark hinge clearance makes mechanical continuity ambiguous, not demonstrably broken.
observations.mobile_closed: Closed lid and clasp are aligned; full object and controls fit. Birch texture and corner joints become blockier at this scale.
observations.mobile_open: Full lid, tab and feet fit. Fine parallel banding on the inner surfaces and stepped green-rim joints are conspicuous.
observations.marketing: Same blue pond and three sage forms, birch finger-jointed body, green seam, brass caps/clasp/round disk/ring and speckled pebble feet; more organic grain and softer shading.

finish_limitations: Repeated bark and inner wood stripes are more graphic than the promotional grain.
Lake, islands, feet and hardware read more faceted; fine edges stair-step on mobile.
uncertainties: Raised lid hinge contact and exposed clasp tongue are partly occluded; no mechanical certification from stills.
entries.reason: Main motif counts, palette, construction and framing are preserved without a definite gross mesh defect.
entries.parent_reconciliation: Parent records a pass without package holds; cold visual findings support a bounded candidate pass only.

observations.desktop_closed: Brown nutmeg with scarlet wrapping, paired pale fruit forms, stem/green accent, warm wood, dark finger joints and brass fittings are retained.
observations.desktop_open: Empty wood-lined cavity, red rim and plain wood lid underside are coherent. Rear hinge gap and long projecting tab are visible; rim ends look stepped.
observations.mobile_closed: Whole ornament, chest and rough gray feet fit; two-line heading and controls do not overflow. Narrow red seam is visible beneath the seated lid.
observations.mobile_open: Lid and tab remain fully framed. Thin dotted/striped wood highlights and pixel-stepped metal details limit small-scale finish quality.
observations.marketing: Same botanical arrangement and hardware layout; rough gray feet also occur in the reference and are not an invented viewer defect.

finish_limitations: Viewer wood is more regularly banded and flatter-lit than promotional wood.
Mace strands, brass and rim junctions are more angular; rough stone feet contrast with the wood in both images.
uncertainties: Lid hinge continuity, hidden feet and clasp attachment cannot be certified from the static angle.
entries.reason: Reference identity and both states are coherent and unclipped; rough feet and red seam have reference support rather than constituting confirmed defects.
entries.parent_reconciliation: Consistent with parent's bounded visual pass; final user approval remains absent.

observations.desktop_closed: Fractured basalt columns, green growth, black slab lid with cyan river/ice feature, stepped riveted brass guards, clasp/round fitting and ring retain identity; full object fits.
observations.desktop_open: Raised black-framed gray inner lid and empty dark cavity are readable; thin uneven rim strips, a small cyan edge fragment and exposed tab warrant close-angle follow-up, not a confirmed break.
observations.mobile_closed: Full silhouette and controls fit; dark lower edges blend into the background and fine vegetation/river details become jagged.
observations.mobile_open: Raised lid and base remain uncropped. Flat segmented greenery and rough rim strips are evident. Back-right title wraps awkwardly across lines without clipping.
observations.marketing: Explicit promotional illustration with more polished reflective obsidian, richer organic moss/stone detail and translucent-looking ice; motif and hardware remain comparable.

finish_limitations: Viewer lacks the promotional mirrorlike lid reflections, nuanced rock weathering and apparent water/ice depth.
Bright segmented greenery and faceted stone are more graphic; dark shading reduces inspection of hardware and lower edges.
Mobile version label wraps awkwardly; this is a minor layout limitation rather than an art failure.
uncertainties: Thin rim overhangs and hardware seating are visually ambiguous; stills do not prove detachment or collision.
Dark underside and rear contacts cannot be mechanically certified.
entries.reason: Bounded visual candidate pass, but overall needs-user-review preserves independent source/package holds. No art failure is inferred from those holds and no release approval is granted.
entries.parent_reconciliation: Parent's needs-decision is retained: visual pass does not clear historical inventory or archive exact-byte discrepancies.
package_holds: Full historical source inventory not verified
Selected archive/Git exact-byte mismatch retained; newline-only is not exact identity

independent_archive_hold.note: Inherited evidence only: newline-normalized equality does not establish exact-byte identity. This visual review reran neither source inventory nor archive comparison.
